keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury David Luiz (Pafos).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Ruud Nijstad (Twente) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Twente 0, Pafos 1. Lelê (Pafos) right footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner.
Lelê (Pafos) is shown the yellow card for excessive celebration.
Goal! Twente 1, Pafos 1. Ruud Nijstad (Twente) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Daouda Weidmann with a cross following a set piece situation.
Second yellow card to Lelê (Pafos) for a bad foul.
Substitution, Pafos. Anderson Silva replaces João Correia.
Goal! Twente 2, Pafos 1. Sondre Ørjasæter (Twente) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Younes Taha with a through ball following a fast break.
Substitution, Twente. Lucas Vennegoor of Hesselink replaces Daan Rots.
Substitution, Pafos. Domingos Quina replaces Vlad Dragomir.
Substitution, Pafos. Guga replaces Alexandre Brito.
Substitution, Twente. Thomas van den Belt replaces Younes Taha.
Goal! Twente 3, Pafos 1. Daouda Weidmann (Twente) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Thomas van den Belt.
Substitution, Twente. Marko Pjaca replaces Sondre Ørjasæter.
Substitution, Twente. Jordy Bawuah replaces Daouda Weidmann.
Substitution, Twente. Michal Rosiak replaces Aske Adelgaard.
